title: Vet eval suite
description: The saved eval for one skill: the output structure and rubric drawn from its SKILL.md, and the test prompts. Lives at evals/<skill>/suite.json and is reused by every later /vet run so scores stay comparable.

skill.description: Skill name, as typed after the slash.

skillPath.description: Path to the skill's SKILL.md: relative to the repo root when inside it, otherwise absolute or ~-prefixed.

skillSha256.description: sha256 of SKILL.md when the suite was written. A later mismatch means the rubric may be stale.

structure.description: What the skill's output looks like, as SKILL.md specifies it.

summary.description: One or two sentences: turn pattern (single reply or multi-turn) and the overall shape.

description.description: One required part of the output: a section, block, format, file, or turn rule.

prompts.description: Ordered so that any leading slice is as varied as possible. A run with --sample M uses the first M.

kind.description: structure: the shape of the output. behavior: a process rule visible in the output. outcome: whether the output does its job for the user.

criterion.description: One checkable claim about the output.

pass.description: What the output looks like when the item is fully met.

partial.description: What a half-met item looks like.

weight.description: 3 = core purpose, 2 = important, 1 = nice to have.

appliesWhen.description: Condition under which the item applies; omit for always. Judges mark the item n/a when it is false.

source.description: Where in SKILL.md this comes from: a heading, rule number, or short quote.

structureRef.description: For structure items: the structure element it checks.

axis.description: The main way this prompt differs from the others, e.g. typical, minimal input, ambiguous, large input, unusual domain.

exercises.description: One line on which parts of the skill this prompt tests.

replies.description: Scripted user replies, used in order whenever the skill waits for the user. Empty for skills that never ask.
